```{r}

# Load the review dataset from the project's DATA folder 

data <- read.csv("DATA/marvel_movie_reviews.csv")
head(data)

```






```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Convert review date to Date format
data$review_date <- as.Date(data$review_date)

# Count reviews by month and franchise
reviews_over_time <- data %>%
  mutate(month = as.Date(format(review_date, "%Y-%m-01"))) %>%
  count(month, franchise)

# Plot
ggplot(reviews_over_time, aes(x = month, y = n, color = franchise)) +
  geom_line(linewidth =0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Movie Reviews Over Time",
    x = "Review Date",
    y = "Number of Reviews",
    color = "Franchise"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```




```{r}

library(ggplot2)

# Check whether each review mentions the actor/character/franchise

data$tobey_mention <- grepl(
  "tobey maguire|tobey",
  data$review,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

data$andrew_mention <- grepl(
  "andrew garfield|andrew",
  data$review,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

data$tom_mention <- grepl(
  "tom holland",
  data$review,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

data$miles_mention <- grepl(
  "miles morales|miles",
  data$review,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

data$chris_mention <- grepl(
  "chris evans",
  data$review,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

data$robert_mention <- grepl(
  "robert downey jr|robert downey|rdj",
  data$review,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

data$avengers_mention <- grepl(
  "avengers",
  data$review,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

data$captain_america_mention <- grepl(
  "captain america|steve rogers|chris evans",
  data$review,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

data$iron_man_mention <- grepl(
  "iron man|tony stark|robert downey",
  data$review,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

data$spiderman_mention <- grepl(
  "spider-man|spiderman",
  data$review,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)


# Percentage of reviews mentioning each actor/character/franchise

mean(data$tobey_mention) * 100
mean(data$andrew_mention) * 100
mean(data$tom_mention) * 100
mean(data$miles_mention) * 100
mean(data$chris_mention) * 100
mean(data$robert_mention) * 100
mean(data$avengers_mention) * 100
mean(data$captain_america_mention) * 100
mean(data$iron_man_mention) * 100
mean(data$spiderman_mention) * 100


# Number of reviews mentioning each actor/character/franchise

character_mentions <- c(
  "Tobey Maguire" = sum(data$tobey_mention),
  "Andrew Garfield" = sum(data$andrew_mention),
  "Tom Holland" = sum(data$tom_mention),
  "Miles Morales" = sum(data$miles_mention),
  "Chris Evans" = sum(data$chris_mention),
  "Robert Downey Jr." = sum(data$robert_mention),
  "Avengers" = sum(data$avengers_mention),
  "Captain America" = sum(data$captain_america_mention),
  "Iron Man" = sum(data$iron_man_mention),
  "Spider-Man" = sum(data$spiderman_mention)
)


# Create data frame for plotting

character_df <- data.frame(
  character = names(character_mentions),
  reviews = as.numeric(character_mentions)
)


# Bar plot with labels

ggplot(character_df, aes(x = character, y = reviews, fill = character)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = reviews),
    vjust = -0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Reviews Mentioning Characters and Actors",
    x = "Actor / Character / Franchise",
    y = "Number of Reviews"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```
